definitions.explanation: Wrinkles at the corners of the eyes or around the mouth that deepen when a person smiles. Usually seen as a sign of a cheerful, kind person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目尻|めじり}→目尻：21905_mejiri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{笑|わら}い{皺|じわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: She has laugh lines at the corners of her eyes.
I love my grandmother's laugh lines.

examples.japanese: {笑|わら}い{皺|じわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{笑|わら}って→笑う：00685_warau⟧きた⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧だ。
examples.english: Deeper laugh lines are proof of all the laughing you have done.

notes:
Often written {笑|わら}いじわ, since ⟦{皺|しわ}→皺：05124_shiwa⟧ is a difficult kanji. ⟦{皺|しわ}→皺：05124_shiwa⟧ becomes じわ in compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{目尻|めじり}→目尻：21905_mejiri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{笑|わら}い{皺|じわ}: laugh lines at the corners of the eyes
- {笑|わら}い{皺|じわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to get laugh lines
- {笑|わら}い{皺|じわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧: to have deep laugh lines

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{皺|しわ}→皺：05124_shiwa⟧: wrinkle
- {小皺|こじわ}: fine lines
